title: Pea and Potato Curry Frittata
subtitle: with green curry paste and Parmesan
description: A frittata of golden onion and potato with peas and green curry paste, set in cream and eggs and browned under the grill.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C on grill or top heat. Thaw the peas about 30 minutes ahead.
Melt the butter with the oil in a large ovenproof frying pan. Add the finely chopped onions and fry for about 10 minutes until golden. Add the curry powder and paste and fry for 1 minute.
Add the diced potatoes and keep frying for about 7 minutes until the cubes start to brown. Remove from the heat, add the peas and stir.
Whisk the eggs and cream with salt, pepper and nutmeg. Pour over the onion and potatoes, sprinkle with the cheese and cook for 5 to 6 minutes more until it starts to set.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and brown under the grill for about 8 minutes, until set and slightly golden.
